scope: Palo Alto official preset listing demo inspected read-only through rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper action, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Palo Alto preset listing View demo opened Palo Alto theme demo storefront.

claims.observed: Home uses seasonal and sale campaigns, category mosaic, curated collection and Shop the Look; collection displays 304 products with several facets; PDP offers fit guidance and related-product content.
claims.risk: Rendered page presence does not establish that facets, quick buy, variants or cross-sell actions work as intended.
claims.vsn_guard: Test discovery and fit guidance across responsive shopper flows and check campaign destinations against catalog.

claims.observed: Demo shows discounts, countdowns, low-stock/selling-fast labels, ratings, sustainability/material claims, free shipping and delivery/return statements.
claims.risk: These sample statements are not evidence of live inventory, real reviews, substantiated sustainability or actual merchant terms.
claims.vsn_guard: Connect urgency to authoritative inventory and validate promotion, review, sustainability and fulfillment statements before release.
